description: This shell script is part of the OpenWrt firmware project and contains functions related to configuring and detecting the mac80211 wireless driver. It includes device checks, band defaults extraction, physical device detection, and initialization routines for wireless hardware.

methods.name: check_mac80211_device
methods.description: Checks if a specific wireless device matches given criteria based on device name, path, or MAC address.

methods.name: __get_band_defaults
methods.description: Retrieves default band configuration for a given wireless phy.

methods.name: get_band_defaults
methods.description: Processes band defaults obtained from __get_band_defaults to set mode, channel, and bandwidth.

methods.name: check_devidx
methods.description: Checks and updates device index based on radio device naming.

methods.name: check_board_phy
methods.description: Associates a device to a board-specific PHY configuration.

methods.name: detect_mac80211
methods.description: Main routine to detect available mac80211 wireless devices, gather their configurations, and initialize wireless device settings in UCI.
